readings: shape2-72 (the shape reading of the page)
rulings.why: System 4 is one row for all stanzas: before the double bar the stanzas' shared last line ('When there's' ... 'at home', 5 words, the 7.5.7.5.7.7.7.5 metre's eighth line), then after the Refrain mark the refrain's first line, whose last word opens system 5. The database writes the shared line as stanza 1's line 8 and the refrain's first line whole (6 words); the reader wrote the shared line as an other row and cut the refrain at the system's end, so its row 1 (5 words) is counted where the database's line 8 stands.
settles: 652 shape (shape2-72): the refrain after stanza 1: row 1 opens "love at" at two places its count gives
